label: Bible Study
prompt: Be ye _____, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verse: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
note: Anger isn't banned here — just given a sundown curfew.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: _____ ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
verse: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
note: Isaiah turns from judgment to hope with a double 'comfort ye' — the first words sung in Handel's Messiah.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And forgive us our _____, as we forgive our debtors.
verse: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
note: Many congregations pray 'forgive us our trespasses,' but the KJV's Lord's Prayer in Matthew says debts.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the word of God is _____, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verse: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
note: 'Quick' is KJV for living, as in 'the quick and the dead' — Scripture is alive and cuts deeper than steel.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy _____.
verse: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
note: Among the Old Testament verses most quoted in the New — Jesus used it to stump the Pharisees in Matthew 22.
